site.description: A small collection of complete Framer websites for businesses that care how they look. Choose one, make it yours, and publish without starting from an empty canvas.

bundle.note: The three current templates, plus Nostalgia.exe when it ships.

templates.name: BELLUCCI
templates.tagline: A bridal makeup template built to turn a browsing bride into a booked date.
templates.description: BELLUCCI is for bridal makeup artists who book weddings, not just post galleries. It is a light-led story rather than a portfolio wall: it opens on the morning of the wedding, moves through how a finish reads in window, ceremony and evening light, then closes on an enquiry form that already asks for the wedding date, the venue and how many people need makeup. Editorial black and cream, Mazius Display and General Sans. Every layer is native and editable on the Framer canvas, so you swap photography and rewrite copy without touching code.
features: Draggable light comparison slider, window light against evening light
Scroll-controlled Light Study through three moments of light
Enquiry form capturing wedding date, venue and party size
Real Brides CMS collection you edit in the panel
included: 8 sections on a single designed page
Hand-tuned desktop, tablet and phone breakpoints
Free updates through your remix link
bestFor: hair and makeup duos taking wedding bookings
beauty artists who want enquiries, not just likes

templates.name: Atrium
templates.tagline: A portfolio you walk through like an exhibition.
templates.description: Atrium mounts your work in gilded museum frames under a starry night. A scroll-driven gallery cross-fades from piece to piece with museum wall labels, and a click-to-open lightbox shows every piece full screen. Six designed pages, CMS-ready Works and Journal collections, and a built-in editing guide. Everything is native and editable on the Framer canvas: swap the demo art for your own in a couple of clicks, no code needed.
features: Scroll-driven gallery with museum wall labels
Exhibitions timeline + Journal with article pages
included: 6 pages: Home, Works, About, Exhibitions, Journal, Contact
Free updates through your remix link
bestFor: creative studios presenting a body of work
artists who want work hung, not listed

templates.name: The Collection
templates.tagline: A creator storefront that reads like an edit, not a wall of links.
templates.description: Turn your link in bio into a real shop. The Collection is a mobile-first storefront for fashion, beauty and lifestyle creators: a magazine-style hero introduces you, curated edits group the pieces you actually recommend, and a weekly product feed runs off the CMS so your links never go stale. Everything is native and editable on the Framer canvas. Swap the photos, rewrite the copy, drop in your products, change two fonts, publish. No code needed.
features: Editorial hero with live intro + 3D tilt
included: Email capture wired for your list
Free updates through your remix link

templates.name: CUT
templates.tagline: A video editor's portfolio, cut like a film.
templates.description: CUT is a video editor portfolio and filmmaker website template for Framer. Dark and cinematic, built for video editors, filmmakers, videographers, colorists and cinematographers who need a fast, fully editable site to show their reel and land better clients. Viewfinder hero, a horizontal-scroll showreel gallery, and a dedicated Works page that plays YouTube, Vimeo or self-hosted video on click. CMS-driven projects, fully responsive, native and buyer-editable.
included: Desktop horizontal scroll, native vertical on phone
Free updates through your remix link

templates.name: Still
templates.tagline: A film photographer's contact sheet, alive.
templates.description: Still is a portfolio template for film photographers and visual artists. Your work hangs on a contact sheet, marked up, circled, honest. Editorial type, a photo archive CMS, and motion that stays out of the photograph's way.

templates.name: Fern Hollow
templates.tagline: Boutique stays and cabin rentals, warm and quiet.
templates.description: Fern Hollow is a free template for boutique stays, cabins and rentals. Warm photography-first layout, gallery and booking sections, and copy that feels like a host, not a hotel chain. Free, forever.

templates.name: The Aubrey
templates.description: The Aubrey is a dark, cinematic template for members' clubs, bars, restaurants and hospitality brands. Candlelit motion, a velvet-rope invitation flow, events and journal CMS, the whole house, ready to open.

templates.name: Brookmere
templates.description: Brookmere is a single-page template for boutique finance, wealth management and private advisory firms. Serif restraint, an emerald palette, and a working invitation form, quiet money, done right.

templates.name: Nostalgia.exe
templates.tagline: A Windows-XP operating system as a portfolio.
templates.description: Nostalgia.exe turns your portfolio into a fully working retro operating system. BIOS boot, draggable windows, Minesweeper, a BSOD 404 and three easter eggs. The portfolio nobody closes in five seconds.
bestFor: Designers who want to be remembered
